The Scheme not only covers tuition fees but also provides a monthly stipend to eligible students to support their basic living expenses throughout the duration of their studies. The Scheme focuses on STEM, Medicine, Law, Accounting, Finance and Psychology undergraduate degree programmes to align with Sarawak’s talent development needs. Sarawak FTES is another initiative by the Sarawak Government to strengthen the education sector and support Sarawak’s aspiration of becoming a developed state by 2030. Apakah Skim Pendidikan Tinggi Percuma Sarawak (FTES)? The Sarawak Free Tertiary Education Scheme (FTES) is a Sarawak Government initiative that provides free tuition fees for eligible Sarawakian students pursuing approved Bachelor's Degree programmes starting in 2026. This Scheme also covers an annual stipend of RM 15,000 per year to students from households with a monthly per capita income of RM 1,500 or less. Skim Pendidikan Tinggi Percuma Sarawak (FTES) ialah inisiatif Kerajaan Sarawak yang menyediakan pembiayaan yuran pengajian kepada pelajar Sarawak yang mengikuti program Ijazah Sarjana Muda yang diluluskan mulai tahun 2026. Skim ini turut merangkumi tambahan wang saku (stipend) sebanyak RM15,000 setahun untuk pelajar yang berasal daripada keluarga berpendapatan bulanan per kapita isi rumah RM1,500 dan ke bawah.
